description: Straßenwidmungen Samtgemeinde Barnstorf is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Overview of dedicated streets in the velvet community of Barsntorf - local roads, community connecting roads, outdoor streets. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Road dedications Samtgemeinde Barnstorf" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
